name: Valdepeñas
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Valdepeñas has long been known for clarete, made by mixing white and red grapes.

blurb.text: A DO in the south of Castile-La Mancha, shown here with La Mancha, which almost surrounds it. Its traditional clarete was made by fermenting red Tempranillo and white Airén together, a style the current rules no longer list. Rules allow Tempranillo, Airén and Garnacha Tinta, among others.
